headline: AfD supporters celebrate Saxony-Anhalt win: 'Siegmund has given us back a sense of unity that had been missing in Germany'
description: Supporters of the far-right Alternative for Germany gathered in Magdeburg to celebrate Ulrich Siegmund's victory in the Saxony-Anhalt state election on Sunday. While falling short of the outright majority it had hoped for, the party nonetheless achieved a historic result, with 44% of the vote.

headline: The end of a lawless paradise? Local government seeks to take back control of Corsican islet
description: Cavallo, a little gem of the Lavezzi archipelago, has always sparked envy. Once the scene of wild parties, it drew the international jet set before becoming a target for nationalists and organized crime groups. In June, the local government launched an offensive to regain control of the port and open the island up to tourists.

headline: Racism and hazing: After the suicide of 21-year-old Joris, a rural French town searches for answers
description: The family of 21-year-old Joris Laurencin is convinced that his suicide in mid-July was linked to the racist insults and repeated bullying he endured at the hands of one young man and his gang. The courts have opened an investigation against persons unknown for 'hazing, verbal abuse, repeated death threats based on race, psychological harassment and incitement to suicide.'
